text:
The bug is in `toolz/functoolz.py`, inside `memoize`. Its `cache` parameter defaults to a single mutable dictionary (`cache={}`), so every decorator invocation that does not supply an explicit cache closes over the same dictionary and can return another function’s cached result.

I intend to change the default to `cache=None` and initialize a new dictionary inside each `memoize` invocation when no cache is provided. Explicitly supplied cache objects will continue to be used unchanged.
